l1.text: At the edge of the valley, where the hills fold into the dusk, there lived a small keeper of lanterns.

l2.text: Every evening, Pip climbed the old hill to wake the great lantern, so that travellers below could find their way home.

l3.text: But tonight, the flame would not catch.

l4.text: So the fireflies came, one by one, and lent it their light.

l5.text: And far below, every window answered.
